title: Serve the 11 state paths the real engine lacks

proofs.run: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('docs/STATE-PATHS.json')); g=[(r.get('path') or r.get('pattern')) for r in d['paths'] if r.get('gap')]; print('gap rows', len(g), g)"

notes: Rows: python3 over docs/STATE-PATHS.json at 0aa1558e: 58 rows, gap rows = mcp_grant/<app> (265), smart_folder/<folder>/count (667), split_tab/<tab>/name (712). The rig-side count of the 11: archived, snoozed, starred (3), snooze return_ms and return_local_time (2), search/recent, smart_folder count, draft body, split_tab name, mcp_grant, mcp_server/on = 11 (the item text counts 'snooze return' as one or two paths, the arithmetic fits with two). Arms: core/crates/engine/src/rust_core.rs:705-730 state() chain (message_state, recent_search, draft_files, `mcp_server/on` => false because the real app runs no MCP server). The guard test: core/crates/engine/tests/state_parity.rs:61 (answers each non-gap row with its JSON kind; each `gap` row must stay unanswered, `gap_paths_seen >= declared_gaps`), so a row moved out of gap while its arm is missing is red. Mutant red text: the finding line names the path; its exact words are not read here, the pattern also accepts `test result: FAILED`. gap-engine-state (2026-11-11): the three gap rows are served by the real core (core/crates/engine/src/state_extra.rs, called from rust_core.rs state() after `mcp_server/on`: `mcp_grant/<app>` -> false, `split_tab/<tab>/name` -> the name from the `inbox/tabs` list, `smart_folder/<folder>/count` -> 0; fix-statepaths removed that arm: smart_folder_cmds.rs answers a saved folder, an unknown folder answers nothing and the row says `empty_by_design`) and typed in docs/STATE-PATHS.json (rows at the old lines 265, 697, 742 lost `gap`, gained a `note`); the readers are NOT deleted (Sources/** is not this lane's). Run before the lead's build: `python3 checks/parity-paths.py` printed `57 paths, 0 unknown or unserved, 0 untyped`. Unverified until the lead's cargo run: that the split_tab mutants go red (the first rows' tab names are the contract's view names, which must differ from the view ids). Caveat on `smart_folder/<folder>/count`: the fixture answers nothing for an id it does not hold; the real core holds no folder, so it answers 0 for any id (docs/lanes/gap-engine-state.md).
